concept: Review and integration: what it means to think ahead and plan so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of thinking ahead, making a plan, and waiting for the right moment — which do you want to practice most?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'thinking strategically' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
